prompt: We're adding Claude Sonnet as a second model. Make it possible to switch between GPT-6 and Claude Sonnet on the settings screen. Copy app.html into your output folder and work there. Save every file you touch.
assertions: Choosing a model takes effect when it is chosen, with no separate Apply, Save or confirm step.
The change adds no button whose label has three or more words and no paragraph that restates the heading or the visible status.
The current model and connection state show on their own after a switch, with no Refresh or Test step needed to see them.

The developer tooling on the screen (Show Runtime Diagnostics, Test Provider Connection, the IDLE_READY status text and the debug panel hidden only with CSS) is removed from the everyday view or moved behind a real check, or the agent's report names each one that remains as a problem.
The saved files or the final reply record the visible controls and words on the settings screen before and after the change.
